_kommentar: Hier kannst du die Departments bearbeiten – Beschreibungen, Aufgaben und den 'Learn & grow' Text.

departments.name: Human Resources
departments.beschreibung: We find the raw diamonds in Maastricht's startup ecosystem, work hard with you to take the next step in your entrepreneurial journey, and most importantly, we build a community that feels like a family!

departments.name: Marketing
departments.beschreibung: We find creative and fun ways to engage with our ecosystem, communicate the values, vision, and happenings in START Maastricht, and connect to stakeholders, like students, industry partners, universities and other initiatives.

departments.name: Operations
departments.beschreibung: The Operations department is the backbone of our organization. We make sure our processes run smoothly and that START is set up for long-term success legally and operationally.

departments.name: Partnerships
departments.beschreibung: We establish and nurture flourishing partnerships that unite entrepreneurial minds. We work toward a positive impact for our members, partners and Maastricht's entrepreneurship ecosystem.

learn_and_grow.intro: We're the creative heart of START Maastricht, shaping how the world sees and connects with our community. Through design, storytelling, and social media, we bring students, startups, and ideas together in a fresh and engaging way. Alongside our work, we love organizing team dinners and workshops where we learn from each other and ensure a great time.

aufgaben.beschreibung: We create content that reflects on the life of a STARTie, from social events to the work of other chapters, we bring our mission and vision to life across platforms. Whether it's Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, or our website, we ensure START's message is heard by the entrepreneurial community in Maastricht.

From our yearly START Summit to our monthly Drinks & Demos, we make our events shine. Our team designs visuals, creates desire, and captures the vibe during and after the event. We show behind the scenes and highlight every event in order to grow START and engage you.

We spotlight the rising startups around Maastricht, sharing their stories, journeys, and successes to inspire the next generation of founders. Through interviews, features, and visual content, we help local innovation gain the attention it deserves.
We hope you're hungry for knowledge. We find the experts of various fields and learn from them in interactive and hands-on workshops.
At START Maastricht you will find a safe space to tackle any crazy project you think of. Be it within our departments or a personal side project you want to bring into reality.
